text: Takashi Masuzaki (増崎孝司, Masuzaki Takashi; born 8 December 1962, in Nagasaki, Japan) is a Japanese guitarist, composer, and arranger under Being Inc. and a member of the fusion band DIMENSION [ja]. His career began in 1983 when he signed with a music agency and became primarily active as a musician and back band member. In 1987, he joined the band Bluew (1987–1989) as a guitarist and simultaneously became a consistent member of the live tours for singer Mari Hamada. In 1990, he released his first solo work, "Speaks," under BMG Victor, and joined the group B.B. Queens, which won the 32nd Japan Record Award and appeared in the national new-year program Kōhaku Uta Gassen. After the group's dissolution in 1992, he joined the fusion band Dimension with saxophonist Kazuki Katsuta and keyboardist Akira Onozuka, remaining an active member as of 2023. In 2003, he released his first collaborative album, Tsuki, with Japanese guitarist Koichi Yabori from the band Fragile. In 2005, he participated in a guitarist session with Michiya Haruhata from Tube and Yoshinobu Ohga from OOM, contributing to the compilation album "Theatre Of Strings," produced and composed by Japanese guitarist Tak Matsumoto from the rock band B'z. In 2011, he took part in the B.B. Queens reunion, contributing to the recording of a compilation and new original album. However, unlike other members, he did not participate in the Live Tour "Being Legend" in 2012. Since 2012, his agency has launched an annual event, Being Legend: Guitar summit, in which he performs live with younger musicians such as Akihide from Breakerz, Hiroshi Shibazaki from Wands, Shinji Tagawa from Deen, Takashi Gomi from T-BOLAN, and Michiya Haruhata from Tube. In 2014, he became a member of the Mario Kart band, performing in the games Super Mario Kart 8, Mario Kart 8 Deluxe, and Super Mario Odyssey. As of 2023, he has released 3 studio albums and 3 collaborative albums. Note: this list contains only credits for lyrics, composition, and arrangement.
